# **Ordway Leadership**

### Building software users actually love

![](https://ordwaylabs.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Accent-arrows-divider-blue-white-left-small.svg)

![](https://ordwaylabs.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Sameer-Gulati-square.jpg)

### **Founder and CEO**

## **Sameer Gulati**

After having launched several billion-dollar finance applications at some of the world’s leading ERP companies, [Sameer Gulati](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sameergulati/) founded Ordway in 2018 with the vision of building a more flexible billing and revenue automation platform. He wanted to free customers from the constraints that many of the incumbent, rigid financial systems suffered. Over the past few years, Sameer has led Ordway through a period of rapid growth and outside investment as the company has begun to disrupt the recurring billing and subscription management category.

[Full Bio](https://ordwaylabs.com/company/leadership/sameer-gulati-ceo-ordway/)

![](https://ordwaylabs.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Subbu-square.jpg)

### **Senior Vice President of R&D and Operations**

## **Subbu Venkiteswaran**

As Senior Vice President of R&D and Operations, [Subbu Venkiteswaran](https://www.linkedin.com/in/subbu-venkiteswaran/) has responsibility for the research and development, product engineering, operations, security, and compliance functions at Ordway. His team manages the product development lifecycle for Ordway’s solutions. His team is responsible for the innovation behind the Ordway billing and rating engine, revenue sub-ledger, and dynamic product catalog as well as platform features such as workflow, analytics, and integration.

[Full Bio](https://ordwaylabs.com/company/leadership/subbu-venkiteswaran-cto-ordway/)

![](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20426%20426'%2F%3E)

### **Chief Marketing Officer**

## **Steve Keifer**

As Chief Marketing Officer, [Steve Keifer](https://linkedin.com/in/stevekeifer) has responsibility for Ordway’s growth strategy, demand generation, and brand development programs, which are designed to expand the company’s market share in the SaaS, cloud, fintech, AI, and IoT segments. Additionally, he has responsibility for [Ordway’s research practice which publishes thought leadership studies](https://ordwaylabs.com/resources/research) on pricing strategies, subscription management, and billing strategies for recurring revenue business models.

[Full Bio](https://ordwaylabs.com/company/leadership/steve-keifer-cmo-ordway/)

### **Vice President of Client Services**

## **Max Rosenberg**

As Vice President of Client Services, [Max Rosenberg](https://www.linkedin.com/in/max-rosenberg-aa605b41/) oversees all new implementations as well as the customer success and professional services teams.  His team works closely with finance directors, controllers, and revenue operations professionals at hundreds of SaaS and cloud companies to optimize their subscription billing, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, and investor metrics reporting.

![Mike Miele Vice President of Sales for Ordway](data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D'http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg'%20viewBox%3D'0%200%20426%20426'%2F%3E)

### **Vice President of Sales**

## **Mike Miele**

As Vice President of Sales, Mike has responsibility for new customer acquisition through both direct sales an d indirect channels such as ERP software vendors, financial advisory firms, and fractional CFO consultancies.His team works with finance, accounting, revenue operations, and customer success teams to design solutions that optimize their recurring billing, revenue accounting, and investor metrics reporting.Mike’s team includes account executives charged with building new relationships, sales engineers responsible for technical solution design, and partnership managers that establish new referral and reseller channels.
